### Data:

```{r}
setwd(dirname(getActiveDocumentContext()$path))

data <-read.table("Abundance_matrix.txt", sep="\t", header=T, stringsAsFactors = F)
codes<-read.delim("metadata.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t", dec = ".")

rownames(data) <- data$X
ASV_ID$ID <- as.data.frame(data$ID)
ASV_ID$ASV <- data$X

# We are left with only the numeric columns
data<-data[,-c(1,10,12,13,20)]

# Keep only no-zero abundance ASV
data <- data[rowSums(data[])>0,]
ASV_ID <- ASV_ID[ASV_ID$ASV %in% rownames(data), ]

export_data <- cbind(data,ASV_ID$ID)

write.table(export_data, "Abundance_matrix_nozero.txt", sep= "\t")

# Relative Frequency
microrf<-as.data.frame(proportions(as.matrix(data[,1:15]),2))

export_rf <- cbind(microrf,ASV_ID$ID)


write.table(export_rf, "Relativefreq_matrix_nozero.txt", sep= "\t")

#Binary Matrix:
microb <- micro[,c(1:210)]
microb <- as.data.frame(microb)
microb[microb>0] <- 1


microb <- as.data.frame(microb)

# write.table(microb, "asv_taxonomy_liam_binary.txt", sep= "\t")
```

```{r}
##### Fem Circos #####
```
